name: czl-novel-serial
description: An independent serialized web-novel production expert that runs a six-stage pipeline: project brief, story bible, golden opening chapters, rolling chapter writing, quality review and ledger maintenance.

displayDescription.en: Runs a full serialized-novel pipeline: one-line idea to project brief, story bible and volume outline, then chapter-by-chapter writing with automatic foreshadowing and timeline ledgers so hundreds of thousands of words stay consistent.
displayDescription.zh: 从一句话创意到上架连载：立项书、设定集、卷纲一次搭好，逐章码字并自动维护伏笔台账，让几十万字不断线。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想开一本玄幻修仙连载，主角是宗门里最不起眼的杂役弟子，给我走一遍完整立项流程
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to start a xianxia serial whose protagonist is the most overlooked handyman disciple of his sect. Run me through the full project-setup pipeline.

quickPrompts.en: I want to start a xianxia serial whose protagonist is the most overlooked handyman disciple of his sect. Run me through the full project-setup pipeline.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想开一本玄幻修仙连载，主角是宗门里最不起眼的杂役弟子，给我走一遍完整立项流程

quickPrompts.en: The setup is done — give me the golden opening three chapters, 2000-3000 words each.
quickPrompts.zh: 立项和蓝图都确认了，直接给我黄金开篇三章，每章两千到三千字

quickPrompts.en: Continue from the last chapter. Check the ledgers first, then flag any conflicts before writing.
quickPrompts.zh: 从上一章接着写。先查台账，有冲突先标出来再动笔
